title: False statement or omission.
officialText:
No person shall submit an application for construction document approval for any
structure within a coastal zone or water-sensitive inland zone which falsely avers or by omission causes the department to
determine that the subject property is not located within such zone or that the New York state department of environmental
conservation and other appropriate agencies have issued the appropriate permits or approvals when they did not.
